system: GeTe, two-atom rhombohedral primitive cell (one formula unit): Ge at (0,0,0), Te at (x,x,x) in crystal coordinates; PBE; Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x on 2 MPI ranks

fields.kind: "scf": one self-consistent calculation at the given geometry, with forces and stress
fields.pseudopotential_set: which pseudopotential pair (see pseudopotential_sets); the fully relativistic set switches spin-orbit coupling on (noncollinear, non-magnetic)
fields.a_rh_A: rhombohedral lattice parameter a (edge of the primitive cell), Angstrom
fields.alpha_deg: rhombohedral angle between the primitive vectors, degrees (60 is the face-centred cubic lattice of rocksalt)
fields.x_Te: Te position (x,x,x) in crystal coordinates of the primitive cell (0.5 is the centrosymmetric rocksalt site)
fields.ecutwfc_Ry: wavefunction cutoff; the charge-density cutoff is 8 x ecutwfc
fields.kmesh: n of an n x n x n Monkhorst-Pack mesh in the reciprocal vectors of the primitive cell
fields.kshift: 0: mesh contains Gamma; 1: mesh offset by half a step along each reciprocal vector
fields.degauss_Ry: smearing width; null for fixed occupations

sssp.description: SSSP 1.3 PBE precision choices: GBRV 1.4 ultrasoft Ge (3d10 4s2 4p2, Z = 14; SSSP cutoffs 45/360 Ry) and PSlibrary-1.0.0-derived ultrasoft Te (5s2 5p4, Z = 6; SSSP cutoffs 50/400 Ry); scalar-relativistic

pslibrary.description: PSlibrary 1.0.0 ultrasoft, scalar-relativistic: Ge 4s2 4p2 (3d frozen in the core, nonlinear core correction, Z = 4), Te 5s2 5p4 (Z = 6); suggested minimum cutoffs 20/116 (Ge) and 32/151 Ry (Te)

pslibrary_fullrel.description: the fully relativistic counterparts of the pslibrary set (same generation parameters); calculations are noncollinear with spin-orbit coupling and no magnetization

charge.rule: units = max(1, ceil(N_k * set_factor[pseudopotential_set] * ecut_factor[ecutwfc_Ry] / k_points_per_unit)), where N_k is the number of symmetry-distinct k points pw.x uses for this structure and mesh (returned as charged_k_points; the polar structures x != 0.5 have fewer symmetries than rocksalt and need more k points). Requests above max_units_per_request are refused without charge.
